[[Vanquisher|Vanquish]] [[Dry Top]]. 

== Quest information ==
=== Objectives ===
* Clear Dry Top in the [[Maguuma Jungle]] of all enemies in [[hard mode]].
* See [[Zehnchu]] <nowiki>[</nowiki>[[Zaishen]] Challenge] for your reward.

=== Reward ===
* 5,000 [[Experience]]
* 1,000 [[Gold]]
* Complete the Base Objective for 50 [[Copper Zaishen Coin|Zaishen Copper Coins]].

== Dialogues ==
=== Initial dialogue ===
; [[Zaishen Vanquish]]
: ''"Clear Dry Top in the Maguuma Jungle of all enemies in hard mode."''
{{offer dialogue
|accept = I can do that!
|decline = No, I'm way too busy today.
|ask = There are still threats that remain. Return when you have slain all of the foes that await you at your destination.}}

=== Reward dialogue ===
; Zehnchu
: ''"Excellent work! The Zaishen admire your dedication."''

==Notes==
*Consider holding this quest for three days until the quest to vanquish neighboring [[Ettin's Back]] also comes up.
